answer: Operator Liability Escrow. Each agent wallet routes a small fee into a shared escrow tied to its operator's verified payout account. When collusion detection flags a cluster, the escrow pays bounties to challengers and the operator's future payouts absorb a ripple of penalties across all their wallets. A challenged operator must also post a jetty deposit per cluster before resuming; unspent funds return only after a clean review period. Sybils therefore cost the operator real money and a meadow of frozen revenue per fake identity.
